messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for GPU host 'gpu-host-47' (zone-us-east-1a). Reason: kernel panic / unreachable. Severity: P1. page_id=PD-95871

pagerduty: Incident PD-95871 created and routed to eng-oncall rotation. Escalation: 3m -> 10m -> 20m. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-95871

emma: acked. i'm on it, grabbing console and serial logs. @sam if you can take network check that'd help. :eyes:

sam: on it. running quick health checks now. can we confirm customer impact? any higher-level SLO alarms firing?

devon: checking metrics — API latency for region is normal, but one tenant's job queue shows retries spiking. might be tied to that node.

emma: attaching serial dump snippet (cut):
```
[  123.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: GPU watchdog detected fatal error
[  123.456800] CPU: 1 PID: 3124 Comm: kubelet Not tainted
[  123.456812] Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x50/0x70
  panic+0x1f5/0x3b0
  gpu_watchdog_panic_handler+0x90/0xa0
```

sam: kubectl output from control plane:
```
$ kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-host-47
gpu-host-47   NotReady   kubelet,network-unavailable   45m
```

emma: attempted ssh to host serial, console attached but unresponsive. planning to cordon and drain as soft evacuation to reduce customer risk. runbook-bot, list evacuation steps?

runbook-bot: Evacuation checklist (soft): 1) cordon node: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-47` 2) drain with gracefully 5m grace: `kubectl drain gpu-host-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300` 3) check tenant queue backlog and reroute jobs 4) create RMA ticket if hardware fault confirmed.

emma: doing cordon now. 
emma: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-47` -> node cordoned :white_check_mark:

devon: FYI i'm watching the tenant job queue, backlog is ~120 jobs (baseline 5). rerouting some jobs to spare pool.

sam: starting drain -> `kubectl drain gpu-host-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300`

sam: drain is hanging on two pods in kube-system (nvproxy). i'll force-delete after attempt to gentle shutdown.

emma: force-delete nvproxy pods, then continue. using `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=30 --force`

sam: pods evicted, drain completed. node marked SchedulingDisabled. :white_check_mark:

devon: customer impact assessment: one internal batch tenant saw job retries and 5-10m delay, public API unaffected. no major customer SLA breaches so far, but a small percentage of queued inference jobs were delayed.

emma: filing incident summary and RMA request. hardware team to look at GPU card and power logs. tagging oncall infra. @pagerduty escalate if no progress in 20m.

incident-bot: Noted. Created infra ticket INF-3229 and attached serial logs. Next auto-escalation scheduled in 20m.

sam: suggested temporary mitigations: update routing policy to steer new jobs away from this rack for next 6h, and increase burst capacity in us-east-1 to compensate. i'll open a routing change PR.

devon: opened PR to adjust routing: https://git.internal/routing/PR-847; rolling out now.

emma: thanks all. i'll keep monitoring and will post a concise postmortem if hardware confirmed. closing this thread once infra confirms RMA or node recovers. :v:

pagerduty: Incident PD-95871 acknowledged by emma. Current status: mitigated (evacuation completed). Will re-evaluate if new alerts appear.

incident-bot: Thread closed by emma at 1766123620. Logs and actions saved to incident PD-95871.
